source_inspections.remaining_obligations: Inventory actual assets, actors, trusted/untrusted domains and OS/admin/hardware assumptions; connect threats, protected outcomes, controls, implementation, telemetry, hostile tests, residual risks and recovery. Exercise unauthorized access, tamper, disclosure, denial, dependency/key loss and evidence replay. Preserve failures and dissent; no scan, unit suite or dashboard establishes total security.
source_inspections.actual_original_non_applicability_body: May be recorded only when an approved current security architecture covers the exact scope, version, environment, data, threat conditions, and change with no material effect. Purely descriptive or synthetic work may remain proposed, but cannot claim security acceptance.

Profanity, unusual questions, criticism or one feedback event imply neither compromise nor hostile intent. No new community moderation, surveillance, user accusation or irreversible semantic enforcement is introduced.

source_inspections.bounded_subject: Purpose-bound data, derived inference and deletion respect explicit current authority
source_inspections.decision_reason: CETA processes linkable conversations, preferences, files, embeddings, outputs, observations and evidence under user control.
source_inspections.remaining_obligations: Inventory actual source/class/purpose/subject/processor/flows and authority without inferring lawful basis or consent. Enforce minimization, authorized retrieval, project/user/session isolation, notice/choice, correction, scoped non-overwriting export, revocation, retention and deletion including indexes/caches/backups. Test stale grants, identity mismatch, changed purpose, inference leakage, model reuse and restore. Notices, deletion events and valid shapes do not prove actual rights handling or forgetting.
